summary: The Wisconsin Association of School Boards (WASB) opposes any sunset or major restriction of the E‑Rate program, urges preservation of broadband and internal network support, and argues that screen‑time policy decisions should remain at the state/local level. The WASB urges the FCC to protect E‑Rate so that public schools can continue to provide reliable, affordable, and effective connectivity for students.
